note: Control identifiers (AC-2, AU-6, ...) are generic labels for readability only. This catalog is NOT a claim of conformance to NIST 800-53, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or any published framework. It exists to demonstrate evidence-to-control review.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: Accounts are provisioned under policy and access is reviewed periodically.

controls.title: Audit Log Review
controls.description: Logs are centrally collected and reviewed on a defined cadence.

controls.title: Information Backup
controls.description: Backups are scheduled and periodically test-restored.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.description: Multi-factor authentication is enforced and a password policy exists.

controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.description: An incident response plan exists and incidents are documented.

controls.title: Vulnerability Scanning
controls.description: Systems are scanned for vulnerabilities and findings are remediated.

controls.title: Cryptographic Protection
controls.description: Data is encrypted at rest and in transit.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation (Patching)
controls.description: A patch management policy exists and patches are applied and logged.

controls.title: Security Awareness Training
controls.description: A training program exists and completion is tracked.

controls.title: Personnel Termination
controls.description: Access is revoked promptly when personnel are terminated.

controls.title: Physical Access Control
controls.description: Physical access to facilities is controlled and logged.
